title: ToolResult
description: The outcome of executing a ToolCall (F-ADP-03). In a conversation a ToolResult travels as a message `{"role": "tool", "toolCallId": ..., "content": ...}` (see GavioRequest message). Consecutive tool-role messages answering parallel calls are merged into one provider turn by the adapter where the provider requires it (Anthropic, Gemini). PiiGuard and the secret scanner scan `content` like any other message content.

content.description: Tool output as text. Structured output is JSON-encoded by the caller.

name.description: Optional tool name. Used by providers that match results by name when the originating call is not in the supplied history (Gemini, Ollama).

isError.description: True when the tool failed. Anthropic receives is_error; Gemini wraps content as {"error": ...} instead of {"output": ...}; OpenAI and Ollama have no flag, so the error text travels in content.
